claim.summary: Exact T12-owned component commands and Catalog-declared component or behavior events cross one bounded generic adapter bridge without exposing platform targets, callback authority, or unvalidated payloads.

semantics.t12Authority: Bind captures one exact Catalog, snapshot, command/event port owner, and component callback owner; normalized command admission is exact-owner and one-shot.
semantics.commands: Direct, replayed, foreign-owner, stale-target, malformed, and reentrant command requests fail closed; adapters receive only command plus detached input.
semantics.events: Current snapshot, exact ticket and owner, T12 authority, and Catalog event declaration are checked before one payload validation; authority is rechecked before a selector-only event-turn request.
semantics.behaviors: Behavior capability and attachTo capability-or-category authority are Catalog-derived and remain owned by one exact current component ticket.
semantics.identity: Factory identities and opaque ticket WeakMaps preserve exact generation and prevent foreign, stale, or ABA-equivalent authority.
semantics.retention: Component scope aliases and repeat keys are detached under aggregate occurrence/code-unit budgets; behaviors share the owner projection without double charging it.
semantics.reservation: Registration reserves both its publication snapshot and enough remaining snapshot capacity for every accepted live binding to unregister.
semantics.reentry: Transition, command, event-reflection, and event-dispatch fences deny mutations and disposal while nested event admission remains FIFO-compatible.
semantics.disposal: Disposal adopts current same-origin T12 cleanup authority, tolerates an already disposed lower manager, revokes old local authority, tombstones tickets, clears graphs, and publishes a minimal terminal bridge tombstone.
